crossRefs.note: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of…
Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make…
Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,
ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, and…
Those officers provided food for king Solomon, and for all who came to king Solomon’s table, every man in his month.…
They also brought Barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man…
also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.
Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him…

translations.web: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.
translations.bsb: He will appoint some for himself as commanders of thousands and of fifties, and others to plow his ground, to reap his harvest, and to make his weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.
translations.kjv: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and will set them to ear his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.
translations.asv: and he will appoint them unto him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will set some to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.
